message.content: In response to LiHua's request for tips to improve his endurance, Jennifer provides several practical suggestions. First, she recommends incorporating longer cardio sessions and interval training into his routine. This approach involves alternating periods of intense exercise with rest or low-intensity activity, which can enhance cardiovascular fitness and help prevent overtraining. Jennifer also advises mixing up different types of cardio activities, such as cycling, running, or swimming, to keep the workouts engaging and varied. Additionally, she emphasizes the importance of proper hydration and nutrition. Ensuring adequate fluid intake and consuming foods rich in carbohydrates and proteins can help replenish energy stores and aid recovery, allowing LiHua to sustain his workouts more effectively.
